purpose: Adopted Factory/Agency design obligations within the existing #65 UX source projection; no new stories, schema, runtime or evidence store.
standing: design-commitment; original design adopted 2026-09-14, owner-directed parallel-UI layout refinement 2026-09-18; no implementation or human-experience verdict

design_amendments.authority: Owner commission to integrate and merge planning for the current parallel UI refinement; O:I #373/#375/#289/#65
design_amendments.scope: Guardian-stewarded product repertoires, bounded intent-led Skill suggestions, claim reception, native Day/NOW/Git/telemetry links and DSH-inspired but DSH-independent right desk
design_amendments.standing: Historical layout revised on 2026-09-18; functional requirements retained

design_amendments.authority: Owner request to simplify the parallel Factory UI around Run, Agents and Context while preserving Factory, Grok Bot and Buzz functions
design_amendments.scope: Three top-level Factory tabs; centre Agent/team Chat or full SSSF Run view; object-local inspection and material opening
design_amendments.standing: Owner-selected layout for immediate parallel-branch experimentation, not final visual acceptance
design_amendments.preservation: Fourteen obligation IDs, story bindings and evidence grades retained; obsolete presentation clauses replaced, underlying functions retained and located in executable user interactions.

centre: existing full SSSF multi-lane Run view
presentation_resolution.supersedes: Six peer sidebar destinations from PR #373: Trajectory, Context, Skills & tools, Claims & evidence, Results, Inspect. Their functions remain object-local depths, not hidden substitute top-level tabs.
presentation_resolution.ordinary_companion: Retain docked conversation when it is the sole chat, shared Agents/Context/activity components, and Direct work without fabricated Run ancestry.
presentation_resolution.scope: Existing parallel UI preparation; no native-runtime rewrite or dependency on DeepSeek Harness.

factory289.policy: Original native and functional obligations remain. Current sidebar navigation is determined by the September-18 handoff; historical layout wording does not restore the superseded six-tab taxonomy. Source mapping is not execution or human EX.

obligations.requirement: Factory sidebar has Run, Agents, Context beside selected Agent/team Chat or the full SSSF Run view. Retain ordinary companion functions and actual right-hand material opening, selected work/output, one transcript/composer, drafts, focus, detach/redock, leave/re-entry and restart.
required_branches: Background completion never moves layout or selection.
Selecting a Surface never redirects the Agent or discloses source.
Ordinary centre chat returns to sidecar without duplication.

Current handoff §4: exactly three top-level Factory tabs; trajectory is under Run, repertoire/setup under Agents, material/evidence/history under Context or the relevant Run event. Inspect is an item action, not a destination.
Retain six current app entrances, world/paradigm context and the complete generic desk with DSH absent.
No selected Run/chat leaves Agents and Context usable. Agent roster selection, chat recipient, inspected step and selected Run remain distinct; explicit filters/pins do not silently redirect work.

obligations.requirement: Agents tab supports readable roster, personal/Project scope, intent-first create/review/use, reusable teams and organisation, actual assignment/outcome ownership, bounded helpers and native durable-source recognition for Keep as Agent.
required_branches: No raw refs as ordinary create inputs.
Temporary participant does not require invented durable profile.
Unavailable team member remains represented.
Resolve six existing Product Guardians and their maintained native repertoires/proposals; do not remint them, copy six inventories or confuse them with the three-member O:I bootstrap SkillSet.
Retain exact intent-expression; explicit bounded AIKit search plus inference proposes a reviewable setup, while manual search and existing-Agent Continue work without inference.

Grok/Buzz retained functions: New Agent/New Team, member organisation, named outcome owner, open conversation/activity/computer, distinct add-to-team/address/assign/delegate actions, retirement without losing historical work.
Team defaults and per-member/task exceptions remain scoped. Selecting a team does not union privileges, invoke all members or make one super-Agent identity.

obligations.requirement: Compact Direct/Factory session interaction resolves Agent, harness/edition, real Model policy/routes, environment/worktree/host, repertoire, context and permissions together; existing Continue is immediate.
required_branches: Changing harness/task re-resolves model and tool eligibility.
Change timing is now/reconnect/new session as natively supported.
Unavailable route or credential gets precise recovery, not invented World/authority.
Resident selector does not stand in for full Model roster integration.
Suggestions disclose reason, native source/revision, scope, prerequisites, gaps and target compatibility; changed intent/catalogue/permissions invalidate stale proposals before validation/apply.
Saving an Agent, assigning a repertoire, starting work and granting authority remain separate. Inference timeout/cancel/no model leaves manual operation usable; panel open/keystrokes invoke no model.

obligations.requirement: Manage Skills and Capabilities within Agents; inspect selected/projected/confirmed-effective/blocked/unavailable practice. Context Sources distinguishes available, selected and actual historical disclosure per act. Useful work proves required material and practice reached the selected session.
required_branches: Projection-file write alone does not prove loading.
Unavailable loading readback is labelled, not guessed.
Method stays within current Skill identity/classification and nested SkillSets.
Excluded/private material is not disclosed by selection.
Root and two differing Project/Profile repertoires preserve inheritance/task overrides and source/overlay revisions; fresh Agents discover bodies and companions and use them without oracle answers.
Brokered, observed, adapter-inferred, unknown and pending-reload states remain distinct; a new Generation does not prove a resident session reread it.
Agency management and System use the same native resolver/config operations, not a React registry.
Context add/search/drop/pick/unlink operates on native refs; unlink is not source deletion, SourcePool membership is not loading and team visibility is not disclosure to every member.

obligations.requirement: Central individual or actual team chat retains multiparty To:/@, attributed messages, attachments/skills, semantic coalesced activity, real permissions/interruption and failed-send draft recovery. Address, contribution and bounded delegation retain distinct effects.
required_branches: A second Agent actually acts; one model impersonating voices fails.
Membership/mention does not grant invocation authority.
Keyboard selection/removal/Escape/focus restoration works.
Historical replay is not new live work or duplicated conversation.
Sender claim, supplied evidence and receiver assessment remain separate; repeated/authenticated reports do not confer truth, independence or authority.
Discuss/investigate this preserves exact subject/revision, visible bounded scope and draft. Test incomplete confident returns and adequate current evidence reused without ritual reruns.
Centre Chat/Run switching preserves chat recipient, original conversation, draft and selected Run. It does not mint one Agent per visual lane.

obligations.requirement: Context Produced lists actual partial/final material with native provenance; short chat links open its content in the right pane or chosen placement. Background cues preserve selected work and reviewed revision.
required_branches: Reviewed revision remains fixed while a newer result becomes available.
Switching related work tabs retains output selection.
Close view retains artifact; detach/redock preserves identity.
Selection or receipt never counts as human agreement.
Claim/evidence opens original act, task NOW, historical context and exact result, then returns to the held position.

Produced artifact is not automatically an input, accepted knowledge or an Inbox item. Addressed human Returns appear by the same native ref beside the Run and in Day/NOW/Inbox with actual delivery/review state.
Request changes, respond/include/reject where natively applicable and deliberate reuse as input retain different effects and do not duplicate the document.

obligations.requirement: Open shared structured-data code, verification, report/research, preview/media and handoff bodies from Context Produced using existing native renderers; details/evidence are attached to the material, not required peer sidebar tabs.
required_branches: Agents consume structured records, not scraped HTML.
Required missing verification stays visible; optional missing metrics do not fabricate data.
Native contained HTML and original Day/Dialogue/CT4b contracts are retained.
Metadata-only cards/ref lists do not satisfy actual content opening.
Preserve source basis, claim modality, challenge and remaining obligations in the relevant document; ordinary human writing is not forced into a proposition form.

obligations.requirement: Context Produced/Returns opens outcome-first handoff: actual/partial state, browsable changes/diff, verification/outstanding work, attributable observations, blocker/next act, canonical continuation and expandable provenance.
required_branches: Opening handoff does not launch a session.
Continue uses the existing session or explicit native new-session interaction.
Queued Run with no attempt cannot yield fabricated completion.
Reported spend and derived estimates retain their distinct basis.
Compaction, T-prime, search and resumed handoffs preserve original provenance/challenges/scope; partial completion cannot close a containing unmet obligation.
Delivery, acknowledgment, Day inclusion, proposal acceptance, Recognition and Git integration stay distinct and invoke their actual native actions.

obligations.requirement: Centre retains full SSSF multi-lane map/frontier and actual correlation; Run sidebar provides compact purpose/control, selected step/attempt, missing legs, timeline/tool/permission/evidence detail, metrics and supplied Run Thought.
required_branches: Show required missing/failed verification and independent legs.
Source/semantic to exact execution/evidence remains navigable.
Queued Run plus unrelated chat/tmux is not Factory execution.
Agent completion, human acceptance and Git integration stay separate.
No miniature sidebar graph or transcript replaces central SSSF fork/barrier/convergence/Candidate functions. Run opens the full view and selected real conversations/environments.

Start/continue, permission, scoped interrupt/cancel, safe retry/replan, request evidence/changes and Candidate review use real owner states; cancellation and quiescence are not conflated and retries reconcile uncertain effects.
Timing/tool detail uses shared bounded cursors, lazy history and deduplication with causal/occurrence/receipt/coverage distinctions.
Native CLI/Agent/UI statistics, comparisons and source search drill to the same evidence; optional analytics/export providers are not canonical stores or prerequisites.

obligations.requirement: Git comparison/history is available on Context sources/results and related Run checks; actual repository/worktree and exact source/test basis are preserved and external CLI changes reconcile.
required_branches: Preserve human dirty/staged/unstaged/untracked work.
Committed, staged and working comparisons remain identifiable.
Later edits expose stale evidence instead of green on unspecified code.
Consume current AIKit Git operations and finish required public seams at their native owner.
Original basis A, moved target B and Candidate C retain verification and task/NOW/context lineage; Git author metadata is not authenticated Agent attribution or runtime context history.

obligations.requirement: Relevant Run/Agent/Context attention cue and quiet footer expose the same native pending item; exact activity is openable anywhere, including Observatory/alternate Surface, with local reachability recovery.
required_branches: No top Factory horizon, extra Attention tab or generic transport chrome is required.
Progress is Activity, not Inbox flooding.
Available/working/needs-input/failure follows native evidence.
Visibility does not broaden permission; reachable alternate Surfaces preserve actual session continuity.
Permission/blocker stays attached to the operation and actionable even when another sidebar tab is selected. Its linked cue/Inbox/Run views resolve together, not through duplicate requests.
Buzz-derived notification projections deep-link the same semantic item; footer and historical review stay quiet and stable.

obligations.requirement: Agents exposes recurring responsibility and proven practice setup; Run exposes actual occurrence; Context exposes output and addressed NOW/Day/Inbox Return with native time/lineage and retained human writing.
required_branches: No duplicate Factory temporal database or midnight scheduling.
Stale proof or revoked authority blocks unattended consequential effects.
Duplicate trigger/restart must not duplicate effects.
Ordinary recurrence stays quiet; consequential blockage becomes attention.
Agent/team routine lists purpose, trigger/enabled/next/last result where known; disable future triggers does not cancel current work, and opening occurrence preserves actual Run/session identity.
Two Workcell-root NOWs and scoped children survive Day rollover/offline/late Return; panel/index refresh invokes no model.
Semantic evidence, sampled diagnostics and human Day contributions retain separate coverage/retention; optional exporter loss is not fictitious lossless data.

obligations.requirement: Three clear Factory tabs with content-first Run, actionable Agents and Sources/Produced Context; current Expressions tokens, no stacked banners, usable empty/degraded states, real keyboard/pointer/narrow interactions and native pane/window continuity.
required_branches: Global Expression Stage only; reduced/interrupted motion keeps interaction usable.
One pane failure preserves unrelated work.
Missing production operations remain named implementation work, not silent removal or fixture success.
Source tests/screenshots alone do not supply human visual acceptance.
Retain accepted left-files interaction and DSH independence; do not restore the six-tab taxonomy through overflow.
Virtual/lazy history, paused/Resume live, stable rows/scroll, collapse, split/detach/redock and maximise preserve native state and drafts.
Current UI dev scenarios are directly openable without live chat/Run. Empty, proposed, running, blocked, reviewing and degraded states have actual interaction, not inert labels.

obligations.requirement: Within the existing programme, exercise organisation/intent/skills → actual Run and chat → bounded child/permission → source/Git/result/check → human receiving/feedback → recovery → Guardian practice and recurrence, using the three-tab layout without discarding native scope.
required_branches: Actual Factory authority crosses Actuation's native gate.
Retain supported harness/provider branch coverage; DSH is not required by this generic UI and unavailable/unsupported/failure remains explicit.
Keep exact source/build/install/running and original failed evidence.
Partial smoke, prose and generated human verdict do not close the whole.

Existing Guardian receives a finding, refines native practice under review and independent fresh reuse, then proposes only warranted suite routing improvements; no automatic governance promotion or six copied manuals.
CLI/config/Agent/UI readbacks agree and a disconnected production handler fails integration tests.

Parallel UI-preparation with labelled interactive fixtures proceeds now; installed/provider/material/human acceptance stays distinct. No audit/pull/reset prerequisite and no pause of the current UI lane.

closure: Required functions and branches remain unexercised until appropriate source-qualified native/provider/material/human evidence exists. The September-18 three-tab layout supersedes earlier presentation labels but does not close broader obligations. #289/#375 implements UI, #220 native integration, #201/#202–205 proves, #65 retains the campaign.
